in_sanskrit.name: पुण्डलिक
in_sanskrit.meaning: पुण्ड (punḍa) - to heap, collect; लिक (lika) - mud; पुण्डलिक (punḍalika) - one who collects mud
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who collects mud or cleanses the earth.

in_hindi.name: पुण्डलिक
in_hindi.meaning: पुण्ड (punḍa) - उठाना (uṭhāna) - to heap, collect; लिक (lika) - प्रभात (prabhāta) - dawn; पुण्डलिक (punḍalika) - संदहन (saṃdahan) - one who purifies, cleanses
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who purifies or cleanses at dawn by collecting mud.

in_tamil.name: புன்டலிக
in_tamil.meaning: புன் (puṉ) - mud; டலிக் (ṭalika) - one who collects

in_telugu.name: పుందలిక
in_telugu.meaning: పుంద (puṁda) - to heap, collect; లిక (lika) - mud; పుందలిక (punḍalika) - one who collects mud
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who collects mud or cleanses the earth.

in_marathi.name: Pundalik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Devotee of Lord Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pundalik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A man who was a great devotee of Lord Shiva. He was a simple shepherd who lived in the village of Shivapur. Despite his lowly status, he was a deeply devoted follower of Lord Shiva and would often perform rituals and offerings to the deity. His unwavering faith and devotion eventually earned him the blessings of Shiva and he was granted the title of 'Pundalik'.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Pundalik একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A man who was a great devotee of Lord Shiva.
